title: Highlights List
description: The tour highlights band — live's `#highlights .entry-content`, measured 2026-08-28. The list is not authored blocks: it is the WYSIWYG `highlights` field arriving through a block binding as raw `<ul>` markup, so every rule here is a descendant selector and none of it can be a structured property. Live strips the marker, hangs a gold check-circle in the gutter and runs the list in two columns from 768px up (custom.css:2412-2419, tour-operator style.css:1203-1233). The marker glyph and the column rule are in assets/styles/core-group.css because a `css` field drops any rule containing `content:` outright and unwraps `@media` into unconditional rules. The empty trailing paragraph is live's too — the editor saves a ` ` after the list — and it is collapsed rather than left holding a line of space.

styles.css: & ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding-left: var(--wp--preset--spacing--30); } & ul li { position: relative; padding-left: var(--wp--preset--spacing--30); line-height: var(--wp--custom--line-height--body); break-inside: avoid; } & ul li + li { margin-top: var(--wp--preset--spacing--20); } & ul ul { margin-top: var(--wp--preset--spacing--20); padding-left: var(--wp--preset--spacing--40); } & > p:empty { display: none; } & > p { margin: 0; }
